title: Force Core
requirement: You must defeat Rosch at Judgment Cliff in Standard Chapter 3 to win his BROKEN LIMB. Then, return to "The Beginning" node and talk to Sonja to receive the FORCE CORE.

title: The Fallen Capital
requirement: Upon arriving at Alma Mine, choose to "Wait in Ambush" to unlock this ending.

title: Night Watch
requirement: During "The Beginning" node, choose to "Join the Rosch Brigade". Head down to the First Ward and talk to the soldier on the left to receive this sidequest. The earliest opportunities you have to buy the two Anti-Sleeps are at the Sand Fortress in Standard Chapter 1 or in Alistel in Alternate Chapter 1. Repeat the first step and give the two Anti-Sleeps to the soldier to complete this sidequest and receive the Alistel Edge (ATK+16/MAG+6).

title: Soldier Recruit
requirement: During "The Beginning" node, choose to "Join the Rosch Brigade". Talk to the receptionist behind the desk on the left side of the first floor of the castle to receive this sidequest. Head to the inn and talk to the two mercenaries. Return to the receptionist to complete this sidequest and receive 1500 G.

title: The Queen Ascendant
requirement: During "The Bridge at Lazvil" node, head to Lazvil Hills. Go west to the Highway and down the ramp to revise your destination. Walk south to the Woodland Path East, west around the river, and north to the other side of the river. Choose to "Go to Alma Mine" to unlock this ending.

title: A Sealed Path
requirement: During the "Beastkind" node, head west to the guard checkpoint at Gran Plain. Choose to "Force your way through" to unlock this ending.

title: The Sister
requirement: During the "Madness of Heiss" node, return to the "Aht's Prayer" node. Defeat Heiss to unlock this node.

title: The King's Daughter
requirement: During "The Bridge at Lazvil" node at Alistel, head to the tavern at the Second Ward. Climb the stairs to the left and in the upper left corner, talk to the girl, named Anna, to receive this sidequest. During the "An Ancient City" node at Granorg, head to the item shop at the Commercial District, and talk to the merchant there. During "The Resistance" node at Granorg, talk to Eruca. She can be found wearing a cloak, by a tree at the center of the Downtown area. Tell her to "Fulfill your duty". Return to the "To Granorg" node and talk to Anna to complete this sidequest and receive the RABBIT'S FOOT (MP+10/LUC+15). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking "The Show Goes On" part of the true ending.

title: Princess' Charge
requirement: Follow the above steps up to talking to Eruca. Instead, tell her "Don't push yourself" to unlock this ending.

title: What Was Inherited
requirement: During "The Bridge at Lazvil" node at Alistel, head to the weapon shop at the Second Ward. Talk to the kids nearby to receive this sidequest. Climb the stairs and enter the upper right house. Talk to their father about the sidequest. During the "An Ancient City" node at Granorg, head to the merchant on the left side of the Downtown area. I think you need to talk to the merchant on the right to get some information, though I'm not sure if this is mandatory. During the "To Cornet Village" node at Cornet, talk to the farmer in the field on the right. Return to the "To Granorg" node and talk to the father. Initially, choose "Don't tell him" about the conuts. This will unlock another option. Return to the same node and choose "Tell about reforestation" to complete the sidequest and receive the PANDUR (ATK+4/MAG+24/SPD+1). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "Overseers of Time" part of the true ending.

title: Distorted Hope
requirement: Follow the above steps up to talking to the father again. Instead, choose to "Tell him" about the conuts to unlock this ending.

title: Accident in the Cave
requirement: After learning the Bomber skill at Lazvil Hills, return north to where you met the spy and enter the cave. Use the barrel to blow away the rocks. Examine the corpse to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Beginning" node and choose to Join the Rosch Brigade. Continue on with the plot as before and return to the site of the cave-in. Use the barrel to blow away the rocks. Talk to the soldier to complete the sidequest and receive the RIGHT-CUT SCROLL for Marco, needed for the "Marco the Calm" sidequest.

title: The Ultimate Dish
requirement: During the "An Ancient City" node at Granorg, head west to the Commercial District. Continue west to the merchants and talk to a man, named Hilster, dressed in green, to receive this sidequest. Return to the "A New Mission" node at Lazvil Hills and head to the Woodland Path. Defeat the Giant Boar to receive the SAVORY BOAR MEAT. Do NOT give this to Hilster yet, or you will lose it and have to do this over again. During the "To Cornet Village" node at Cornet, search the left field for a sparkle that is the SAVORY VEGGIES. Return to the "Castle Sewers" node and talk to Hilster to complete this sidequest and receive the FIRELIGHT PACT for Eruca, needed for "The Light Trial" sidequest.

title: Kiel's Talent
requirement: During "The Valkyrie" node, head up to the second floor of the Sand Fortress. Talk to Kiel on the left end of the floor to learn sword-dancing, upgrade your Strike ability, and unlock this node.

title: Front of Despair
requirement: During "The Valkyrie" node, head up to the mess hall at the Sand Fortress in the upper middle room on the first floor, and talk to Rosch to advance the plot. Choose to "Send Reinforcements" to unlock this ending.

title: Marco the Calm
requirement:
During the "A New Mission" node at Alistel, on the right side of the first floor are two doors. Enter the left door and talk to the blue soldier to receive this sidequest. You need to find four scrolls for Marco.

1) Right-Cut Scroll: Reward from "Accident in the Cave" sidequest (see 036).
2) Left-Cut Scroll: Reward from "Despairing Young Man" sidequest (see 103).
3) Sleep Gas Scroll: During "To Cornet Village" at Cornet, Standard Chapter 3, check out the field to the right. Walk up between the upper row of crops and the fence to find a hidden chest which contains this scroll.
4) Roll-Cut Scroll: During "To Holff Ruins" at Abyssia Forest, follow the upper path to a large, open area. Search the upper right corner for a hidden chest which contains this scroll.

After you have obtained any of the scrolls, return to the soldier with them, and he will teach the new abilities to Marco. Learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest.

title: Raynie the Active
requirement:
During the "A New Mission" node at Alistel, on the right side of the first floor are two doors. Enter the left door and talk to the blue soldier to receive this sidequest. You need to find four scrolls for Raynie.

1) Darkshield Scroll: During "The Valkyrie" node at the Sand Fortress, head up to the third floor. Walk around the right side, up the stairs, and through the door. Search the right side of the large room for a hidden chest which contains this scroll.
2) Slumbering Scroll: Reward from "Second Opinion" sidequest (see 120).
3) Poisoner's Scroll: This can be found as early as the "Destroy the Ballistas" node in Standard Chapter 5 at the Itolia Wasteland. From the southern entrance, head north one screen, east one, and north two. Search the upper wall for a hidden chest which contains this scroll.
4) Piercing Scroll: Reward from "The Good Thief's Way" sidequest (see 190).

After you have obtained any of the scrolls, return to the soldier with them, and he will teach the new abilities to Raynie. Learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest.

title: Red-Letter Day
requirement: During the "A New Mission" node at Alistel, head up to the castle and through the right door. Enter the laboratory to the left and talk to the woman, named Meese, to receive this sidequest. If you're doing this as early as possible, you will have to talk to Sonja and Raul, then come back down to talk to Sonja again. Return to "The Beginning" node, talk to Rosch on the first floor, and choose to "Send Rosch". Talk to Meese to complete this sidequest and receive the P.Thauma Spear (ATK+23/DEF+2). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "Iron-Armed General" part of the true ending.

title: A Knight's End
requirement: Follow the above steps up to talking to Rosch. Instead, choose to "Chase after" Sonja to unlock this ending.

title: Flower of Promise
requirement: During the "A New Mission" node at Alistel, talk to the woman by the flowers in the lower right corner on the first floor to receive this sidequest. Proceed to "The Beastkind Forest" node at Celestia. Talk to the Satyros above the save point to receive a Celestian Flower Bud. Return to "The Beginning" node and give it to the questgiver. Continue to the "A New Mission" node and talk to her again to complete this sidequest and receive a THAUMATECH ORB (MAG+5/MDF+5).

title: A Letter to Tomorrow
requirement: During the "A New Mission" node at the Second Ward of Alistel, climb the stairs to the left of the tavern, and head all the way down to talk to the man named Cedric to receive this sidequest. Proceed to "The Valkyrie" node at the first floor of the Sand Fortress. Walk around to the right, into the upper middle room, and talk to Viola. Continue to "Alistel's Offensive" node and talk to Viola again. Return to Cedric and choose to "Show journal" to complete this sidequest. This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "Valkyrie in Repose" part of the true ending.

title: A Voice Unheard
requirement: Follow the above steps up to returning to Cedric. Instead, choosing "Don't show journal" will unlock this ending.

title: Engineer Recruit
requirement: During the "A New Mission" node at Alistel, talk to the receptionist behind the desk on the left side of the first floor of the castle to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Closed Mine" node, leave the mine, enter the house by the entrance, and talk to the engineer, Berman. Return to the receptionist to complete this sidequest and receive 3000 G.

title: Escort
requirement: During the "Secret of the Sewers" node at the Underground Waterway, you need to find Claire in the lower right area of the sewers. Escort her out of the sewers to unlock this node. This is a prerequisite to unlocking the "Something Precious" and "The Impregnable" nodes later.

title: Fated Assassination
requirement: During the "Secret of the Sewers" node, having infiltrated Granorg Palace, choosing "I'll be the decoy" will unlock this ending.

title: Mankind & Beastkind
requirement: During the "Duty Revealed" node at Granorg, talk to the guard by the save point at Main Street, to receive this sidequest. Go west to the inn, walk around its left side, and up the stairs to the west fo find Liese and talk to her. Return to the soldier and talk to him again. Proceed to the "To Holff Ruins" node at Abyssia Forest. Head south, then east two screens and talk to Liese. Return to the entrance, and follow the northern path to the next screen until you reach an open area. Examine the corpse in the upper right corner. Head back to Liese to talk to her again. Return to the "Castle Sewers" node, talk to Liese, and tell her to "Believe in him". Talk to the soldier by the save point to complete this sidequest and receive the PROMISED KNIFE (ATK+27/MAG+75/HP-30) for Aht. This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "Life of the Beastkind" part of the true ending.

title: Chains of Hatred
requirement: Follow the above steps up to talking to Liese at Granorg the second time. Choose to "Leave it to her" to unlock this ending.

title: One & Only
requirement: During the "Duty Revealed" node at Granorg, go west to the inn at the Downtown area. Head upstairs and into the right room. Talk the man, Kaizan, to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Closed Mine" node and talk to the miner in the house. Return to "The Beginning" node, head to the second floor of the inn to find Kaizan and talk to him. Return to the "Castle Sewers" node and talk to Kaizan again. Return to Alistel and talk to him again. Finally, return to Granorg and talk to him to complete this sidequest and receive the Firestar Pact for Aht, needed for "The Starlit Trial" sidequest.

title: Viola's Decision
requirement: After the "Wolf in the Fold" node, return to "Alistel's Offensive and talk to Viola to unlock this node.

title: The Lion General
requirement: During the "Battle of Gran Plain" node, go north one screen and west two. Choose to "Go north" to unlock this ending.

title: Swordsman Recruit
requirement: During the "Homecoming" node at Alistel, talk to the receptionist on first floor, behind the left desk to receive this sidequest. Proceed to the "A New Battle" node. You will need to complete "The Next Foe" (see 136) and "The Road to Victory" (see 137) sidequests. After doing so, talk to Gadeff to recruit him. Continue to the "In Pursuit" node at Alistel, and talk to the receptionist to complete this sidequest and receive 8000 G.

title: Mercenary Recruit
requirement: During the "Homecoming" node at Alistel, talk to the receptionist on first floor, behind the left desk to receive this sidequest. Proceed to "An Introduction" node at Skalla. After meeting with Tarquin, talk to him a few times to get some information on the mercenary. Return to the "Echoing Hills" node, defeat the bandits again, and talk to Tarquin. Return to Skalla and talk to Tarquin again. Finally, continue to the "In Pursuit" node at Alistel, and talk to the receptionist to complete this sidequest and receive 15000 G.

title: Sand Sword
requirement: During "The Resistance" node at Granorg, talk to Will at the bar to unlock this node. Proceed to "An Introduction" node. After arriving at Skalla, follow Tarquin inside his shop to receive the Sand Sword. Return to "The Resistance" node and give it to Will. This is a prerequisite for unlocking the "Will's Sword", "Will to the Rescue", and "The Impregnable" nodes later.

title: Will's Sword
requirement: Return to "The Resistance" node. Proceed with the plot up to the "Capital in Flames" node. If you gave the Sand Sword to Will (see 085), you will automatically unlock this node.

title: Something Precious
requirement: Return to the "Pierre's Betrayal" node. If you rescued Claire from the Underground Waterway (see 061), then you will automatically unlock this node.

title: Will to the Rescue
requirement: Return to the "Wounded Otto" node. Proceed with the plot normally. If you gave the Sand Sword to Will (see 085), you will automatically unlock this node.

title: Stray Lion
requirement: Return to the "Death of a Friend" node. Choose to "Leave it to Marco" to unlock this ending.

title: Despairing Young Man
requirement: During "The Resistance" node at Granorg, go east two screens and up one. Talk to the woman dressed in pink to receive this sidequest. Return to the "Duty Revealed" node, head to the same area, and talk to the man in the cloak. Return to "The Resistance" node to talk to him again to complete this sidequest and receive the Left-Cut Scroll for Marco, needed for the "Marco the Calm" sidequest.

title: Assassination of Dias
requirement: During the "Rescue the Princess" node at Granorg, head to the Castle Gates. Talk to the man in the cloak to receive this sidequest. Return to the "Aht's Prayer" node and proceed to Granorg. Head to the second floor of the inn to find Dias. Talk to him, then choose to "Leave". Return to the questgiver to complete this sidequest and receive the Rose Ring (HP+10/ATK+5). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking "The Lives of Humans" part of the true ending.

title: The World's Betrayal
requirement: Follow the above steps up to talking to Dias. Instead, choose to "Accept invitation" to unlock this ending.

title: Assassination of Raul
requirement: During the "Premonition of War" node at Celestia, talk to Rosch at the Boundary Tree, then Raul, then Barranca. Choose to "Nominate Raul" to unlock this ending.

title: Wandering Soul
requirement: During the "Darkness in Alistel" node, head up and Vanoss will arrive. Talk to him again to receive this sidequest. Proceed to the "Road to Forgia" node and make your way to Skalla. Head to the middle house on the north side of town. Search around the bed for a hidden soul and choose to "Send soul to heavens". Continue to the "Skalla Liberated" node and head to Skalla. Talk to Vanoss at the northwest side of town to complete this sidequest and receive the Cleansing Cape (DEF+30/MDF+36/MAG+5). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "Shaman" part of the true ending.

title: Fleeting Peace
requirement: Follow the above steps up to finding the hidden soul. Instead, choose to tell Aht, "Don't do anything" to unlock this ending.

title: Second Opinion
requirement: During the "Darkness in Alistel" node, go up to the Second Ward and climb the two staircases to the left. Talk to the woman above to receive this sidequest. Return to the "A New Mission" node and talk to the man in the same location. Return to the "Darkness" in Alistel" node and talk to him again to complete this sidequest and receive the Slumbering Scroll for Raynie, needed for the "Raynie the Active" sidequest.

title: Battlefield Missive
requirement: During the "Darkness in Alistel" node, go up to the Second Ward and climb the stairs to the right. Talk to the boy by the weapon shop to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Valkyrie" node, head up to the mess hall where Rosch and Viola were, and talk to the soldier sitting on the bench to receive the Death Pact for Stocke, needed for "The Blades Trial" sidequest. Finally, return to the "Darkness in Alistel" node and talk to the boy to complete this sidequest and receive a Celestial Oil.

title: Aht's Sacrifice
requirement: During "The Tournament" node at Cygnus, win the first two rounds of the tournament. Talk to the mercenary again for round three and choose to "Go with Aht's Plan" to unlock this ending.

title: Hedge in Exile
requirement: During the "Warlord's Request" node, you will receive the Bloodied Armlet. Return to the "Desert City Messiah" node and with the Armlet, you will automatically unlock this node.

title: The Next Foe
requirement: During the "A New Battle" node, talk to the mercenary, Gadeff. Defeat the Crush Bear to complete this sidequest and receive the Pieti Edge (ATK+30/MAG+39/SPD-2). This sidequest is also a prerequisite to the "Swordsman Recruit" and "The Road to Victory" sidequests.

title: The Road to Victory
requirement: After completing "The Next Foe" sidequest, talk to Gadeff again to receive this sidequest. Defeat the Mist Spider to complete this sidequest and receive the Moirae Manteau (DEF+48/MDF+41). This sidequest is also a prerequisite to the "Swordsman Recruit" sidequest.

title: A Friend to Elm
requirement: During the "Celestian War" node, talk to Elm to unlock this node.

title: Blade's Resurrection
requirement: During the "Demigod" node, defeat Hugo the first time to receive the Historica. Return to the "Celestian War" node, and talk to Elm to unlock this node.

title: The Eternal War
requirement: During the "Call to Destruction" node and talk to Raul. Choose to "Join with someone else" and "Team up with Granorg" to unlock this ending.

title: A Beastkind Warrior
requirement: During "The Tournament" node at Cygnus, win the first two rounds of the tournament. Talk to the mercenary again for round three and choose to "Stop Aht". Return to the "A New Alliance" node, talk to Raul, and choose to "Team up with Forgia" to unlock this node.

title: Conversion
requirement:
During the "Celestian War" node, enter the Patriarch's House and talk to Sonja to receive this sidequest. You need to find three cores for Rosch.

1) Impale Core: After learning Mana sight, return to "The Closed Mine" node, leave the mine, and enter the house by the entrance. Search around for a hidden chest which contains this core.
2) Blast Core: During the "In Pursuit" node at the Underground Lab, make your way down to the 5th basement level. Head up past the intersection and hug the left wall until you can go through a path that is rather hard to see. Defeat the Special Thaumachine there to win this core.
3) Haste Core: Reward from the "A Scholar's Creed" sidequest (see 207).

After you have obtained any cores, return to Sonja at "The Celestian War" with them, and she will install them in Rosch's Gauntlet. Learn all three abilities to complete this sidequest.

title: A Mighty King's Death
requirement: During the "Scorched Battlefield" node at Cygnus, talk to Garland at his room. Choose to "Stay in Cygnus" to unlock this ending.

title: An Unwanted Reunion
requirement: During the "Scorched Battlefield" node, head west of the inn to the Plaza. Talk to Ricky along the main road to receive this sidequest. Head to the tavern and talk to the green-haired girl, Mimel, twice. Return to the "Chi-Clad Warrior" node and talk to the bartender. Return to the "Scorched Battlefield" node, talk to Mimel again, and choose to "Let Mimel go." Talk to Ricky again to complete this sidequest and receive the Sable Larme (DEF+33/MDF+25/MAG+5). This sidequest is also a prerequisite for unlocking the "A Little Hero" part of the true ending.

title: Simmering Fury
requirement: Follow the above steps until you confront Mimel the second time. Choose to "Capture Mimel" to unlock this ending.

title: Divine Judgement
requirement: During the "Forbidden Weaponry" node, talk to Rosch and join the meeting. Choose to "Accept the truce" to unlock this ending.

title: Gafka & the Scrolls
requirement: During the "Sand Fortress Siege" node at Forgia, head to the village entrance and talk to Bergas to unlock this node.

title: The Ultimate Skill
requirement:
During the "Sand Fortress Siege" node at Forgia, head to the village entrance and talk to Bergas to receive this sidequest. You will need to find four books for Gafka.

1) Strongman Book: Search the east side of the entrance of Forgia to find a hidden chest which contains this book.
2) Tristrike Book: Reward from "The Beast God's Birth" sidequest (see 175).
3) Wind God Book: On B4 of the Underground Lab, head up to a platform that you should search for a hidden chest which contains this book.
4) Omnipedia Book: Reward from the "A Timely Warning" sidequest (see 213).

After you have obtained any books, return to Bergas at "Gafka & the Scrolls". Defeat him each time and learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest.

title: The Beast God's Birth
requirement: During the "Sand Fortress Siege" node at Forgia, talk to Galva to receive this sidequest. Proceed to "The Royal Secret" node and head to Gran Plain. Go north, west, and south one screen to South Hill. In about the lower left corner, you will see a cross on the ground. Examine it to obtain the Beast God's Nail. Return to "Gafka & the Scrolls", talk to Galva, choose to "Wait" and "Stop the ceremony" to complete this sidequest and receive the Magic Fist Forza (ATK+67) and TRISTRIKE BOOK for Gafka, needed for "The Ultimate Skill" sidequest. This sidequest is a prerequisite for unlocking the "Beast God at Rest" part of the true ending.

title: Beast God's Reign
requirement: Follow the above steps until you begin the ceremony. Choose "Don't say anything" to unlock this ending.

title: At Journey's End
requirement:
This one is very tricky, as it has prerequisite choices to even access the sidequest, and the game doesn't tell you. There are three decisions you have to make over the course of the game.

1) During the "Breakthrough" node at Gran Plain, head north one screen and west to the checkpoint. You will hear someone in distress back east. Make sure to choose "Let's go save her now."
2) After the "Wolf in the Fold" node, return to "Alistel's Offensive" and talk to Viola. Return to the "A Meeting Too Late" node and proceed with the plot normally. Make sure to choose "I leave it to you."
3) During the "Commander's Fall" node at the Sand Fortress (SAND6), defeat the Thaumaton boss at the end. Afterwards, make sure to choose "Bring back now."

Despite that last decision occuring AFTER the time when you can access the sidequest, it is indeed a prerequisite. Return to the "Gafka & the Scrolls" node and head to Skalla. Talk to Marco by the item shop. Then, talk to Raynie by the inn and choose "I can't give up." Talk to Marco again to complete this sidequest and receive the Priere Bonheur (ATK+15/MAG+32/Fear Res+5). This sidequest is a prerequisite for unlocking the "A Warrior in Love" part of the true ending.

title: Oncoming Calamity
requirement: Follow the above steps until you talk to Raynie about Marco's concerns. Choose "I'll stop fighting" to unlock this ending.

title: Merchant Tarquin
requirement: During "An Introduction" node, enter Tarquin's shop and talk to him to unlock this node.

title: Premature Invasion
requirement: During the "Overcoming the Trial" node, talk to Bergas and choose to "Lead the way" to unlock this ending.

title: The Impregnable
requirement: If you have already unlocked the Escort (see 061) and Sand Sword (see 085) nodes, then this will be automatically completed during the plot.

title: Moon Armlet
requirement: During the "Waiting at Skalla" node, return to Cygnus and talk to Garland to receive this sidequest. Head to the Itolia Wasteland, then go north one screen, east one, and north two. You should see a small rock formation in the middle. Search around there for the hidden Moon Armlet. Return it to Garland to complete this sidequest and receive the Suna-Watari (ATK+42/SPD-4).

title: The Good Thief's Way
requirement: During the "Waiting at Skalla" node, return to Cygnus. Talk to Hertz & Bram by the equipment shops to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Beginning" node at Alistel and talk to the child by the tavern. Return to the "Castle Sewers" node at Granorg and talk to the boy to the left of the inn. Finally, return to Hertz & Bram to complete this sidequest and receive the Piercing Scroll for Raynie, needed for the "Raynie the Active" sidequest.

title: The Living Legend
requirement:
During the "Waiting at Skalla" node at the Itolia Wasteland, go north one screen, west one, and continue west and up to a well. Climb down the wall to meet a man named Sword to receive this sidequest.

Return to "The Beginning" node at Alistel. Talk to Wand, the boy inside the weapon shop, and choose "Hope." Return to "The Messenger's News" node and search the upper right corner to find the Shade Pact for Stocke. Return to the "Castle Sewers" node in Granorg. Talk to a man in the lower left corner named Pentacle, and choose "The past." Return to the "How to Disappear" node, go down the sewers, and head west one screen. Search the left of the upper paths to find the hidden Sunlight Pact for Eruca. Return to "The Beastkind Forest" node and talk to Chalice, the lady by the equipment shop and choose "All things". Search to the left of the sparkling bushes at the center of town to find the hidden Meteorite Pact for Aht. Talk to Sword again to complete this sidequest.

title: The Three Contracts
requirement: After completing "The Living Legend" sidequest, talk to Vainqueur to unlock this node.

title: The Blades Trial
requirement:
After completing "The Living Legend" sidequest, talk to Vainqueur to unlock this sidequest. You will need to find four Pacts for Stocke.

1) Fire Pact: After learning Mana Sight, return to "The Beginning" node at Alistel. Head down to the First Ward, and search the alley behind the item shop for a hidden chest which contains this Pact.
2) Death Pact: Reward during the "Battlefield Missive" sidequest (see 121).
3) Shade Pact: Found during "The Living Legend" sidequest (see 191).
4) Soul Pact: During "The Road Perilous" node, defeat all the Floating Stones at the Royal Hall. In the upper right part of the area are hidden barrels. Drag one of them all the way down to the rocks at the beginning. Blow away the rocks in the upper right corner to get a hidden chest which contains this Pact.

After you have obtained any Pacts, return to Vainqueur at "The Three Contracts" and he will teach the new abilities to Stocke. Learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest. This sidequest is also a prerequisite to gain access to "The Final Trial" sidequest.

title: The Starlit Trial
requirement:
After completing "The Living Legend" sidequest, talk to Vainqueur to unlock this sidequest. You will need to find four Pacts for Aht.

1) Firestar Pact: Reward from the "One & Only" sidequest (see 069).
2) Meteorite Pact: Found during "The Living Legend" sidequest (see 191).
3) Thunderstar Pact: During "An Introduction" node at Skalla, search below the weapon shop for a hidden chest which contains this Pact.
4) Icestar Pact: During "The Sacrifice" node at the Imperial Ruins, climb down to the lowest level. In the upper right corner is a secret passage you can walk through to a hidden room. Search for a hidden chest which contains this Pact.

After you have obtained any Pacts, return to Vainqueur at "The Three Contracts" and he will teach the new abilities to Aht. Learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest. This sidequest is also a prerequisite to gain access to "The Final Trial" sidequest.

title: The Light Trial
requirement:
After completing "The Living Legend" sidequest, talk to Vainqueur to unlock this sidequest. You will need to find four Pacts for Eruca.

1) Firelight Pact: Reward from "The Ultimate Dish" sidequest (see 037).
2) Protection Pact: During the "Gladiator" node at Cygnus, head to the Back Alley area by the tavern. Search behind the wall in the lower left corner to find a hidden chest which contains this Pact.
3) Sunlight Pact: Found during "The Living Legend" sidequest (see 191).
4) Divine Pact: Found in a hidden chest at Holff Ruins.

After you have obtained any Pacts, return to Vainqueur at "The Three Contracts" and he will teach the new abilities to Eruca. Learn all four abilities to complete this sidequest. This sidequest is also a prerequisite to gain access to "The Final Trial" sidequest.

title: The Final Trial
requirement: After completing "The Blades Trial", "The Starlit Trial", and "The Light Trial", talk to Vainqueur again to receive this sidequest. Defeat him to complete this sidequest and receive the True Historica (ATK+70/MAG+34/SPD+5).

title: Hugo the Omnipotent
requirement: During the "In Pursuit" node at the Underground Lab, make your way down to the lowest basement level. Talk to Hugo and choose to "Take the power" to unlock this ending.

title: Thaumatech's End
requirement: During the "In Pursuit" node at Alistel, talk to the old man just outside the Underground Lab to receive this sidequest. Then, make your way down to the 5th basement level. Head up past the intersection and hug the left wall until you can go through a path that is rather hard to see. Defeat the Special Thaumachine there. Walk all the way out of the Underground Lab and talk to the old man again to complet this sidequest and receive a Medibranch.

title: A Scholar's Creed
requirement: During the "In Pursuit" node at the Underground Lab, make your way down to the 7th basement level. Hug the left wall until you can go through a path that is hard to see. Talk to the engineer there to receive this sidequest. Return to "The Beginning" node. Talk to Fennel in the lab next to the infirmary to complete this sidequest and receive the Haste Core for Rosch, needed for the "Conversion" sidequest.

title: A Timely Warning
requirement: During the "Shadow Crown" node at Granorg, head east to the weapon shop. Talk to the nearby man in green to receive this sidequest. During the "Royal Secret" node at Granorg, talk to him again. Finally, return to the "Shadow Crown" node to talk to him to complete this sidequest and receive the Omnipedia Book for Gafka, needed for "The Ultimate Skill" sidequest.

title: After Heiss
requirement: After "The Madness of Heiss" node, return to the "Aht's Prayer" node. Defeat Heiss to unlock this node.
